name: Humans Last Hope
source:
You are a destiny that decides not only your own future, but also the future of others.

Your actions in this world will directly depend only on you.

Every choice you make affects these universes.

If you restart the world, then your actions will remain in that universe. You will not be able to correct the mistake you made in the previous universe.

Will you be able to change the fate of the world in the form of a sixteen-year-old boy. Will you be able to accept the role of the fate of this world?

If yes, then go ahead, a traveler through the multiverse.

And remember, Omega is always watching your actions.

[From [url=https://rui314.itch.io/humans-last-hope-fvn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你就是命运本身，不仅决定自己的未来，也决定他人的未来。

在这个世界里，你的行动只由你自己决定。

你做出的每一个选择，都会影响这些宇宙。

即使重启世界，你曾经做过的事也会留在原来的宇宙中。你无法修正自己在上一个宇宙犯下的错误。

你能以一个十六岁少年的身份，改变世界的命运吗？你能接受自己就是这个世界的命运吗？

如果可以，那就前进吧，穿梭于多元宇宙的旅人。

还有，记住：欧米伽始终注视着你的一举一动。

[摘自[url=https://rui314.itch.io/humans-last-hope-fvn]Itch.io[/url]]
